# Task Launch Policy

An abstract Connected Clause marker for policies that invoke the package-owned Work request function. It identifies a policy’s purpose without defining a concrete launch action.

`parameters.workClause` defaults to `work`, expressing the intended Work clause reference. This marker contains no executable use of that parameter. Its empty `bindingTypes` declares no property bindings, and it supplies no concrete action body, launch trigger, actor or task arguments.

Inherited Connected Clause behavior turns named action connections into native channels and workflows. Executable hooks, templates and action declarations come from the admitted exact clause type. Bindings must name declared properties or actions. Clause names must be nonempty and contain no `.`, `/` or `~`. The inherited transition check requires an existing clause to remain unchanged under its current key; changing its configuration requires a new clause key.

The marker defines no task lifecycle status or completion result. Invoking a Work request expresses a request; it does not confirm acceptance, execution or completion. Those outcomes require evidence from the Work implementation.
